text: Men Ɓamtiri senngo dow maɓɓe fello ngon sabu ahadi maɓɓe ndin no ɓe hunnira ndin, Men Wi'ani ɓe ɓaawo ɗum : "Naatiree Bayt al Maqdisi on ko on naayiiɓe", ɓe hucci ɓe naati, Men Wi'ani ɓe : "Wata on jaggitir ñalnde asewe nden yunngugol", haɗaali ɓe jaggiti ɓe yunngi, Men Nanngi e maɓɓe ahadi tiiɗundi, ɓe firti ahadi ndin.
